description:
What an amount of money in one quarter is worth in another, by the NZ CPI.

    Use for: 'what is $100 in 1990 worth today NZ', 'cpi nz', 'inflation since 2000
    nz', 'cpi adjustment 2026', 'adjust for inflation nz', 'how much has inflation
    gone up', 'value of money in 1970'.

    USES THE OFFICIAL STATS NZ CPI, not an assumed inflation rate: series
    CPIQ.SE9A, All groups for New Zealand, from 1914, the same series the site's
    inflation calculator reads. value = amount x CPI(to) / CPI(from).

    OMIT to_year FOR TODAY: the latest published quarter is used and named in
    latest_quarter. Before 1926 Stats NZ published one or two quarters a year; a
    quarter it did not publish is refused, with the ones it did.

    Args:
        amount: Dollars in the earlier quarter.
        from_year: Year of the earlier quarter.
        from_quarter: March, June, September or December (or 3, 6, 9, 12).
            Omitted, the year's last published quarter.
        to_year: Year to convert to. Omitted, the latest quarter.
        to_quarter: Quarter to convert to, as for from_quarter.

    Returns:
        The converted value, the total change, the average yearly change and the
        two CPI index numbers used.
name: nz_cpi_inflation_calculator
